say:1:1121243001:0.text: Damian, what's up with that nest of birds?
say:1:1121243001:0.source_cn: 达米安，你面前的这窝小鸟怎么了？

say:2:1121243002:0.text: I picked them up this afternoon on the north side of Lunadorf. They appeared to have been blown out of a tree by a strong wind and had injured their wings.
say:2:1121243002:0.source_cn: 今天下午，我在月湖村北边捡到了它们。它们似乎被强风从树...

say:3:1121243003:0.text: I made tiny braces to help them heal.
say:3:1121243003:0.source_cn: 我为它们制作了固定装置，想帮它们修复骨折的翅膀。

say:4:1121243004:0.text: But Uncle Dyan says that they were also suffering from internal injuries...
say:4:1121243004:0.source_cn: 但是迪恩叔叔和我说，它们不止翅膀骨折了，体内也有骨刺，...

say:5:1121243005:0.text: Uncle Dyan gave me some herbs that would ease their pain. I just wanted to let them pass on as painlessly as I could.
say:5:1121243005:0.source_cn: 迪恩叔叔给了我一些草药，这些草药点燃后的香气可以缓解痛...

say:7:1121243006:0.text: The little birds... are they dead?

say:8:1121243007:0.text: Yes... they stopped moving just before you got here.
say:8:1121243007:0.source_cn: 是的……你们来之前，它们的身体已经不再动弹了。

say:9:1121243008:0.text: Why do you look so sad? Soon they will open their eyes again.
say:9:1121243008:0.source_cn: 为什么你看起来很悲伤呢？它们很快就会睁开眼睛。

say:10:1121243009:0.text: Don't treat me like a child! Don't lie to me.
say:10:1121243009:0.source_cn: 别拿我当小孩子！我可不会相信这种谎言。

say:11:1121243010:0.text: I'm not lying. Mother says that death is like a deep sleep, and after a while you'll wake up again.
say:11:1121243010:0.source_cn: 我没有撒谎。\n妈妈说过，死亡是沉睡，过一段时间就会醒来。

say:12:1121243011:2.text: The dead don't wake up, your mother's lying to you!
say:12:1121243011:2.source_cn: 死亡的生命可不会醒来，你的妈妈在骗你！

say:13:1121243012:0.text: Leave me alone... I just want to bury these little birds.
say:13:1121243012:0.source_cn: 我不想听你胡说了，我要埋葬这些死掉的小鸟。

say:14:1121243013:0.text: You're going to bury them in the dirt? No, they won't be able to breathe when they wake up!
say:14:1121243013:0.source_cn: 你要把它们埋进土里？不可以，它们醒来时会被压得喘不过气。

say:15:1121243014:0.text: Uhh... I'm not sure exactly what you learned about death, but these little birds aren't waking up again, kiddo.
say:15:1121243014:0.source_cn: 呃……我不知道一直以来你是怎么理解死亡的，但是这些小鸟...

say:16:1121243015:0.text: I'll prove it to you. I'm not going anywhere until they open their eyes.
say:16:1121243015:0.source_cn: 我会证明给你们看的，我哪也不去，我要守在这里。

say:17:1121243016:0.text: You're weird! They're gone, and they should be allowed to return to nature.
say:17:1121243016:0.source_cn: 你真奇怪！它们已经走了，应该让它们回归自然！

say:19:1121243017:0.text: Ah, how did it come to this? <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what should I do?
say:19:1121243017:0.male: Ah, how did it come to this? <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what should I do?
say:19:1121243017:0.female: Ah, how did it come to this? <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what should I do?

choice_prompt:20:1121243017.text: Ah, how did it come to this? <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what should I do?
choice_prompt:20:1121243017.source_cn: 唉……怎么会变成这样？<style=stress><player_name></style>，我该怎么办？
choice_prompt:20:1121243017.male: Ah, how did it come to this? <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what should I do?
choice_prompt:20:1121243017.female: Ah, how did it come to this? <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what should I do?

say:21:1121243018:0.text: Hmm... If it keeps her from running away, I guess she can stay for a while.
say:21:1121243018:0.source_cn: 嗯……她要是不再逃跑的话，待在这里也不是不行。

say:22:1121243020:0.text: I'll go get the medicine and then Damian will take you somewhere to rest. You must be tired.
say:22:1121243020:0.source_cn: 那么我去拿药，让达米安带你去休息吧，你跟我们奔波一天，...
say:22:1121243020:0.male: I'll go get the medicine and then Damian will take you somewhere to rest. You must be tired.
say:22:1121243020:0.female: I'll go get the medicine and then Damian will take you somewhere to rest. You must be tired.

say:23:1121243021:0.source_cn: 我们等到天亮了再做打算。

say:25:1121243019:0.text: Well, I suppose I'll fetch the medicine and bring it here. If this keeps her from running away again, so be it.
say:25:1121243019:0.source_cn: 总之我先把药拿来，让她喝下。至于她想待在哪里，只要她不...
